name: Jingdeng Miye
source:
A doctor from Rosecrown Beacon. She has a serious characteristic and cares not only about the physical condition of Illuminators but also offers her own opinions on their lifestyles. Some Illuminators think she speaks too directly, but no one questions that her intentions are always good.

[spoiler]In reality, Puria Crystal has become the head of Rosecrown Beacon, busy every day.[/spoiler]
